# uptimekuma_docker_host (Resource)

A Docker daemon that `uptimekuma_monitor_docker` resources query for container state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_docker_host" "local" {
  name            = "Local daemon"
  connection_type = "socket"
  daemon          = "/var/run/docker.sock"
}

resource "uptimekuma_docker_host" "remote" {
  name            = "Build server"
  connection_type = "tcp"
  daemon          = "tcp://build.internal:2375"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_type` (String) How to reach the daemon: `socket` for a Unix socket or `tcp` for a TCP/HTTP endpoint.
- `daemon` (String) Socket path or TCP address of the daemon, for example `/var/run/docker.sock` or `tcp://localhost:2375`.
- `name` (String) Friendly name for the Docker host.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the Docker host, assigned by Uptime Kuma.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitors, tags, notifications and the rest are imported by their numeric ID,
# which is visible in the Uptime Kuma URL when you open the object.
terraform import uptimekuma_docker_host.example 1
```
